question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools AS s JOIN satscores AS sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400 LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
sql: SELECT * FROM cards WHERE NOT cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL AND NOT cardKingdomId IS NULL LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

question: Which user has a higher reputation, Harlan or Jarrod Dixon?
sql: SELECT DisplayName, Reputation FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') AND Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') )

question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM customers LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS ratio FROM customers

question: Give the name of the league had the most goals in the 2016 season?
sql: SELECT l.name FROM Match AS m JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT t2.name FROM Match AS t1 INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1.league_id = t2.id WHERE t1.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY t2.name ORDER BY SUM(t1.home_team_goal + t1.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account AS a JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district AS dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id WHERE dist.A3 = 'East Bohemia' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT COUNT(T2.account_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.A3 = 'east Bohemia' AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

question: Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
sql: SELECT d.driverRef FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 20 AND q.position IS NULL LIMIT 5
gold: SELECT T2.driverRef FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 20 ORDER BY T1.q1 DESC LIMIT 5

question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
sql: SELECT m.major_name FROM member AS me JOIN major AS m ON me.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE me.first_name = 'Angela' AND me.last_name = 'Sanders' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'

question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
sql: SELECT sp.power_name FROM superhero AS sh JOIN hero_power AS hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sh.superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

question: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND p.Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0) AS percentage, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND p.Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation FROM Patient AS p WHERE p.SEX = 'M' LIMIT 1000
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
